lessons.title: Strategy for explanation
lessons.vector_text: writing_communication. explanation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Identify the audience's prior knowledge and exact question; lead with the answer, define only necessary concepts, then build the causal or logical chain with one useful example.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Remove each paragraph in turn and verify every remaining paragraph contributes to understanding the target question.

lessons.title: Strategy for summary
lessons.vector_text: writing_communication. summary. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Preserve the source's main claims, evidence, uncertainty and important exceptions while compressing repetition; distinguish source content from added interpretation.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Compare the summary against the source claim-by-claim and check that no material conclusion changed.

lessons.title: Strategy for technical document
lessons.vector_text: writing_communication. technical_document. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define purpose, reader, scope, terminology and acceptance criteria; structure requirements, assumptions, methods, results and limitations so claims are traceable.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Select material claims at random and trace each to data, formula, source or explicit assumption.

lessons.title: Strategy for translation
lessons.vector_text: writing_communication. translation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Preserve meaning, modality, technical terms, numbers and uncertainty before optimizing fluency; flag genuinely ambiguous source text instead of silently choosing.
anti_patterns: fluent rewrite that changes technical meaning
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Back-check critical propositions, quantities and negations against the source.

lessons.title: Strategy for audience adaptation
lessons.vector_text: writing_communication. audience_adaptation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Keep factual content invariant while changing vocabulary, depth, examples and pacing for the audience; do not simplify away conditions that change truth.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Compare expert and adapted versions for invariant facts, quantities and qualifications.

lessons.title: Strategy for decomposition
lessons.vector_text: planning_operations. decomposition. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Convert the objective into deliverables, dependencies, interfaces and verifiable completion criteria; split until work units can be independently checked.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Remove a work package and test whether the objective can still be demonstrated complete.

lessons.title: Strategy for scheduling
lessons.vector_text: planning_operations. scheduling. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Build schedule from dependencies, durations, resource constraints and uncertainty; identify critical path and buffers rather than assigning dates by wish.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Delay each critical activity and measure downstream impact.

lessons.title: Strategy for risk
lessons.vector_text: planning_operations. risk. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Describe risk as cause-event-consequence with likelihood/evidence, exposure, trigger, mitigation and contingency; separate known risks from unknowns.
anti_patterns: risk register containing vague labels only
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: For each high risk, identify an observable trigger and executable contingency.

lessons.title: Strategy for resource allocation
lessons.vector_text: planning_operations. resource_allocation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Map scarce resources to constrained work, compare marginal value and bottlenecks, reserve capacity for uncertainty, and make opportunity costs explicit.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Inject a credible disruption and verify critical work retains recovery capacity.

lessons.title: Strategy for checkpointing
lessons.vector_text: planning_operations. checkpointing. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Checkpoint only reproducible state: completed evidence, hashes, residual blockers and exact next action; distinguish progress narrative from resumable state.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Attempt continuation using only the checkpoint and referenced artifacts.
